build_coco_dataset: build a COCO detection dataset for train or val splits using the build function
create_coco_transforms: create COCO image transforms for training or validation using make_coco_transforms
convert_coco_polys_to_mask: convert COCO polygon segmentations to binary mask tensors using convert_coco_poly_to_mask
filter_coco_categories: filter and remap COCO annotation category IDs using FilterAndRemapCocoCategories
prepare_coco_target: prepare COCO annotations into boxes, labels, and masks using ConvertCocoPolysToMask
